text:
**Kelso Ridge bus changes start Monday 19 January**

- **410:** Weekday peak buses every 15 minutes, up from 30.
- **New 412:** First direct link from Mill Flat to Kelso Ridge station and shopping centre. Runs every 20 minutes, 6am–9pm, seven days a week.
- **408 scrapped:** It averages nine passengers per trip. The 412 will cover its industrial estate stops.
- **Why:** A six-week community consultation found a direct Mill Flat–station link was the top request.
- **Concern:** Industrial estate workers with early starts lose service before 6am. The authority will monitor demand and may add earlier buses.
- **Other:** Fares are unchanged. Printed timetables arrive in December, and the routes appear in journey planning apps in early January. An info stall runs at the shopping centre on Saturday 6 December, 10am–2pm.
